spine.active_goal: Verify, by driving the live app the way a normal user would, that every Field Notes feature works on the Galaxy Note 10+ (Android) and then on the Mac, and report defects ranked by user impact. Bounded by the journeys in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-TEST-PLAN.md, not by statistical gate counts or open-ended edge cases.
spine.next_step: Owner picks the Pinyin option (types it themselves, a macOS VM, or skip) and says whether to start 10.45 and 10.46 now under the no-input design: build a plain test app with its own bundle id into ~/Applications, write a guard variant that ignores hardware events and stops on software-made events or a frontmost change, drop the testkit's set-frontmost lines, launch with open -g, use AX presses and reads only; check for the owner's call before the reminder sound. 10.47 waits for the phone.
spine.landed: macOS end-to-end test complete and verified on d36b748. Criteria c4, c5 and c6 are done: E2E-REPORT.md has the macOS journey table M0 to M15 (all pass), the c5 table (drag confirmed in changed form, file-URL paste was a harness bug, Ctrl+K confirmed), defects ranked Blocks (MB1 Settings invisible to VoiceOver, MB2 reminder never fires on macOS), Hurts (H1 to H11, including the Edit menu dead with a real mouse and Pinyin failing in the editor), Cosmetic (C1 to C8), Android counterparts, harness findings, and a follow-up table for the former hand checks. Every macOS finding is also a thread risk. Verified rather than assumed: the probe accessibility crash is probe-only; the Edit menu failure reproduces with a real mouse; real Finder copy and drag insert photos; spell check works in a real build; no Field Notes build appears in macOS notification registrations. Open: real VoiceOver reading of Settings and the month picker (method proven, needs two minutes of the owner hands-off), and c2 (Android defect entries).
spine.last_session: Wave 1 shipped as 7 draft PRs (#212-#218), all gates pass. Photo lane was unblocked by updating 11 out-of-list assertions to the amended photo rules, then held + --resume. A local merge of all 7 branches analyzed clean and passed the full suite (3229 tests). Goldens CI was still running at report time.

open_risks.text: The Android app does not build as the repository stands: file_picker 11.0.2 skips its Kotlin plugin on AGP 9 while android/gradle.properties sets android.builtInKotlin=false, and enabling built-in Kotlin breaks audio_session and the other KGP plugins. Test builds must apply testkit/patches/android-probe-build.patch; the real fix is the owner's call and is itself a Blocks finding.

Camera, microphone, photo and notification prompts on the phone need the owner's consent; ask once whether the harness may use adb shell pm grant for the probe package, otherwise the owner taps Allow. Voice, video, photo pick and reminder journeys stall without it.

The probe wraps the app in a second ProviderScope, so ref.exists(appSettingsProvider) is false and spell check never turns on in the probe; judge spell check on the plain app build or a single-scope probe.

The phone has no Google account, so Gboard cannot be installed; keyboard journeys use Samsung Keyboard only. Hardware-keyboard chord cases in the harness assume macOS meanings and should not be read as Android defects.

On macOS the screensaver starts after 30 minutes of owner idle and stops unattended runs; keep-awake (caffeinate tied to the queue, display sleep at the end) needs the owner's approval each session and leaves the Mac unlocked meanwhile.
The probe drives the app through FieldNotesApp with isolated storage; a plain app build smoke (A15, M15) is needed to confirm real startup, permissions and storage.
The test kit lives outside the repo at ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit; the Swift helpers must be compiled there and the patches applied to fresh scratch worktrees each session.

The phone has a secure lock (PIN or pattern). The agent never enters it, so any screen-off outside the probe needs the owner to unlock. The probe's FLAG_KEEP_SCREEN_ON covers only its own window; the F24 watcher (scratchpad keepawake.zsh, pokes after 15 s idle when the probe is not in front) kept the screen on all session without changing any setting.

adb input text (and hardware keyboards) take a different editor path from the Samsung soft keyboard: B3 (photo deletion) happens only on the key path, while H4 and H12 were confirmed with real soft-keyboard taps. Judge input-path defects with both paths before recording them.

The accessibility sweep (docs/specs/accessibility-sweep.md) covers the Android layout only. The macOS layout (sidebar shell, Today rail, centred panel pickers, macOS toasts and video controls) must be swept with the same rules as part of the macOS app testing (criterion c3); the owner decided this on 2026-09-25.

open_risks.scope: Android calendar month picker, screen reader
open_risks.text: Month picker regression from #209: while the calendar's month picker is open, the Android accessibility tree is empty. The phone shows 7 unlabelled nodes, against 47 before the fixes; closing the picker restores 55. The cause is the BlockSemantics wrapper added around the picker in lib/features/calendar/calendar_screen.dart (_buildPicker). A probe APK without only that wrapper exposes the picker (73 nodes) but also the calendar behind it. Widget tests show the full picker tree with the wrapper, both in state a5 and in the full AppShell, and with semantics switched on before or after the picker opens, so the mechanism is unexplained. Not confirmed with TalkBack. Evidence: a11y-verify dumps/a5-calendar-picker.xml and probe/a5-picker-without-blocksemantics.xml.

The day sheet's Change mood button (_ChangeMoodButton in DayMoodCard, lib/features/mood/mood_banner.dart) has no 48 dp minimum: it measures 110 by 32.8 dp on the phone. The same card reads the mood twice ("Grateful, Felt Grateful, Chrysanthemum..."). It shows only for a past day that already has a mood, and no widget sweep state renders it, so PR #209 missed both. Evidence: a11y-verify dumps/x-day-sheet-sep25.xml.

open_risks.scope: Android composer More formats menu, screen reader
open_risks.text: The More formats menu items (Strikethrough, Highlight, Inline code) now activate, but they hang under the More formats button's node inside the format bar's HorizontalScrollView. The Android bridge rejects a touch outside a node's rect before trying its children, so a screen-reader touch never reaches them; swiping does. The merged phone tool reports them as small-target in c4-more-formats. This probably predates the PRs; the old tool could not measure it. Not confirmed with TalkBack.

open_risks.scope: Android card Edit/Delete pill, screen reader
open_risks.text: The revealed card pill's Edit note and Delete entry are 48 dp, but their top 15 dp sits above the card's top edge, outside the card node. A screen-reader touch there reaches nothing, and the phone tool reports them as small-target in the day sheet. A finger tap there works (verified 2026-09-26). Not confirmed with TalkBack.

Before the video can play, the viewer's scrubber is correctly disabled, but Android still reports it as a clickable View with no role (missing-role in d4-viewer-video). Once playing, it is an enabled SeekBar.

Painted shifts left by PR #209 after its review fixes:U+000AU+002D The tab bar's Today tab widened from 42.7 to 48 dp, moving Calendar 3.8 dp, + 2.7 dp and Garden 1.5 dp to the right on every screen.U+000AU+002D The calendar's previous-month arrow sits about 8 dp further left, since each arrow now sits at the bottom right of its own 48 dp slot; the next-month arrow is unchanged.U+000AU+000ANo golden covers either. The day header, the top bar and the next-month arrow were restored, and the Add a note row (14 dp) and the viewer panel (9 dp) growth are accepted.

At phone width, the format bar's 48 dp buttons leave room for only Bold, Italic, Heading, Bullet list, Numbered list and Task list, plus Undo and Redo. Quote, Link, Table and More formats sit behind a horizontal scroll with no partial button at the edge to show it scrolls, so sighted users may not find them. The scroll itself was planned in the a11y-fixes spec.

Tap-area overlaps measured on the phone:U+000AU+002D With the keyboard open, the Photo removed toast's Undo photo removal button covers the format bar's Task list by 43 by 44 dp and Numbered list by 17 by 44 dp. The widget state measured 4 dp, because it has no keyboard.U+000AU+002D Add memory overlaps Inline code by about 7 by 44 dp.U+000AU+000AThe owner deferred these to task chip task_e34a20a1 ('Fix the toast and Add memory tap overlaps'), which also adds an overlap rule to the sweep.

In Settings, the Delete all, Export and Reclaim space nodes each span their whole row, 95 to 985 px wide, but only the pill on the right responds to a finger. A tap on the row's label does nothing. Unchanged from the 2026-09-25 sweep; pre-existing.

Widget-test accessibility sweeps can pass while the live platform's accessibility tree differs: the Android month picker is fully labelled in widget tests but empty on the phone. The macOS sweep must therefore read the live app's accessibility tree, for example with Accessibility Inspector or an AXUIElement dump, and not rely on widget baselines alone. Check the month picker first, because the same BlockSemantics wrapper ships on macOS.

The macOS probe cannot be used for accessibility work: with accessibility on, macOS never sees its tree (the wrapper leaves the AX root unattached) and closing the month picker crashes it in AccessibilityBridge::CreateRemoveReparentedNodesUpdate (6 of 6). Use the plain build with the env-gated switch (PROBE_AX=1 posting the AXEnhancedUserInterface notification) and AX presses for macOS accessibility checks.

The macOS accessibility sweep so far is a live AX-tree read of names and roles on 12 plain-app screens. The accessibility-sweep.md rule set (target sizes, overlaps, reachable size) has not been run on the macOS layout, and Settings could not be swept because it never reaches the AX tree (MB1).

Owner hand checks still open on the Mac: spell check and the daily reminder in field_notes_plain, a real Finder copy and paste, Finder drag and drop, a mouse pick from the Edit menu, and real VoiceOver on Settings and the month picker.

open_risks.scope: Mac state left by the macOS run
open_risks.text: Warp still holds macOS Automation permission to control VoiceOver, granted by the owner on 2026-09-27 for the VoiceOver check. Switching it off needs Touch ID or the admin password: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation > Warp > VoiceOver.

Real VoiceOver reading of Settings and the month picker is still open. Method that works: start VoiceOver.app, press Use VoiceOver in Quickstart via AX, capture the caption window (VoiceOver window at layer 3000) by window id and OCR it; step with Ctrl+Option+Right. Needs about two minutes of the owner hands-off; the owner is often on a Discord call, where VoiceOver speech goes to their headset.

macOS MB1 (Blocks, VoiceOver users): the Settings screen never reaches the macOS accessibility tree. Opening Settings leaves the previous screen's nodes (Today text or a Search result) and no Settings control; leaving Settings restores a correct tree. Flutter's own semantics has every row, so the loss is between Flutter and macOS; trigger sits inside SettingsScreen (widget unknown). Seen in the plain build with the AXEnhancedUserInterface switch; real VoiceOver reading not yet run. Evidence results/macos/a11y/settings.txt, a11y_settings.png.

macOS MB2 (Blocks): the daily reminder, on by default, never appears on the Mac. Set for 15:40 on a day with no entry: no banner; no Field Notes build (real, probe or plain) is among the 114 apps registered in com.apple.ncprefs, so no permission prompt was ever reached. ReminderCoordinator cancels silently on refusal and Settings still shows the reminder on. Suspect (unverified): ad-hoc code signing (Signature=adhoc, no team).

macOS H1 (Hurts, VoiceOver users): the open month picker is absent from the macOS AX tree (no months, year arrows, Back to this week or dismiss) while the grid behind stays exposed; pressing Jump to a month again does not close it and grid days do nothing; only Escape leaves. Counterpart of the Android month-picker gap (BlockSemantics in calendar_screen.dart _buildPicker).

macOS H2 (Hurts): a floated photo cannot be placed between paragraphs that sit beside it. Dragging to such a boundary shows the insertion line at the float row's edge and drops there (note end when every later block is beside the float, otherwise back in place); a single Move down also jumps to the end. Undo restores; dragging away leaves an empty paragraph. Carried-forward c5 finding 1, confirmed in changed form.

macOS H3 (Hurts): menu bar Edit > Undo and Redo stay disabled with undo history present; Edit > Paste and Select All change nothing (confirmed with a real mouse); Edit > Copy works; Cmd+Z/Cmd+V/Cmd+A work. A stock Flutter TextField behaves the same, so it is app-wide at Flutter's macOS text-input layer.

macOS H4 (Hurts): Ctrl+K (delete to end of line) does nothing in any text field, including the stock Search field where Ctrl+A and Ctrl+D work (deleteToEndOfParagraph: unmapped in Flutter). Carried-forward c5 finding 3, confirmed.
macOS H5 (Hurts): after Cancel then Keep editing in the Discard dialog, the note editor has no focus and typed letters are dropped until the user clicks into the text (2 of 2).

macOS H6 (Hurts, VoiceOver users): text fields reach macOS with no name. The Search field and the note editor are AXTextField with no title, description or placeholder although Flutter labels them Search your days and Note. Likely Flutter-level (not compared with a stock labelled field). Android counterpart: the editor's unlabelled node.

macOS H7 (Hurts, VoiceOver users): sidebar Today, Calendar, Garden and Search are exposed as AXStaticText with a Press action, not buttons or tabs, with no selected state; the Dismiss mood picker and Dismiss day detail backdrops read as full-window text.
macOS H8 (Hurts, keyboard users): Escape does not close the voice recorder (2 of 2); its Close button does. Escape closes the viewer, the day sheet and the month picker.
macOS H9 (Hurts, keyboard users): no visible focus indicator after Tab in Settings, so a keyboard user cannot see where focus is.

macOS H10 (Hurts): in Settings, Export and Delete all respond only on their button, not on the row label, although each whole row is one accessibility node. Same as the open Android Settings Data rows finding.

macOS H11 (Hurts; blocks Chinese writing): Chinese Pinyin cannot compose in the note editor. With Pinyin - Simplified, real keys zhongwen arrive as plain inserts (composing -1) and Space leaves zhongwen (3 of 3, input method warm). The stock Search field composes zhong wen and Space gives the characters; Japanese romaji composes in the editor.

macOS cosmetic findings: C1 removing or dragging away a photo leaves an empty line; C2 the video recorder timer pill overlaps the Camera label; C3 video card says 0:09 while the player says 0:08; C4 after opening a search result a card's Edit/Delete pill floats over the title bar (hit-testable) until the mouse moves; C5 plural slips 1 Sprouts and Deleted 1 days and 2 entries; C6 search clear button and Text size slider unlabelled in Flutter semantics; C7 the reminder time picker is a 12-hour dial while the row shows 24-hour time, and its typed-entry mode did not take digits reliably; C8 a voice memo leaves data/temporary/voice_*.m4a that neither save nor Reclaim space removes (probe storage; plain not checked). Unverified: a first mood planted on a past day played no sound in one clean trial.

macOS harness findings (not app defects): the probe crashes closing the month picker with accessibility on and never exposes an AX tree (probe-only); tool/probe/macos/pasteboard.swift files writes nothing on macOS 26.5.1 (the old file-URL paste finding); the probe keeps one data slot and switching scenario names wipes it; probes launched from a shell get TCC prompts attributed to Warp (use open -n); the probe shot cannot capture native sheets; scripts/gate.zsh and run_all.zsh point at moved paths; ScreenCaptureKit app-only audio capture misses the app's audio (use all-system capture in a quiet period); dead-key failures of 2026-09-24 came from in-app injection, real keys work.

The 2026-09-27 macOS tools (drivers, watchdog variant, HID, AX, audio, input-source and OCR helpers) exist only as sources in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/tools-2026-09-27 and must be compiled; their scripts expect scratch worktrees macprobe and plain built from patches/macos-probe-native-input-ax.patch and patches/macos-plain-build.patch in the same folder. The session scratchpad copies will be gone.

This Mac has no valid code-signing identity (security find-identity -v -p codesigning: 0 valid identities), and the macOS runner signs with CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY "-" (ad-hoc). A probe of MB2's suspected cause (ad-hoc signing refused notification authorization) cannot be run locally without the owner's Apple developer team.

open_risks.scope: Android probes for the fix spec
open_risks.text: The Galaxy Note 10+ was not connected on 2026-09-27 evening (adb devices empty), so Android root causes for the fix spec rest on widget tests and the 2026-09-26 phone dumps until the owner plugs it in.

MB2 cause corrected 2026-09-27 from the macOS system log: ad-hoc signing is not the cause. The owner's real ad-hoc build got permission on 2026-09-21 23:31 and its reminder fired on 2026-09-22 20:30 (held back by a Focus mode). The real defects: (A) scheduling runs only while the Settings screen is open (reminderSyncProvider watched only in reminders_sound_section.dart:37), and each reminder is one-shot (repeats:false), so no reminder comes unless Settings is opened, and none after the first; (B) a refused permission is silent, and Settings keeps showing the reminder on. The plain test build was refused by usernoted ('Failed to find or validate client'), most likely because it only ever ran from a temp folder (unverified). Android shares A and B.
